task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name and object key from an S3 URI in the format 's3://bucket-name/path/to/object'
solution_criteria: The regex should correctly extract the bucket name and object key as separate groups. It should handle bucket names with hyphens and dots, and object keys with multiple path segments.

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that includes function name, runtime (nodejs18.x), memory (256 MB), timeout (30 seconds), and environment variables for API_KEY and REGION
solution_criteria: The JSON should have valid syntax, include all specified fields with correct data types, and follow AWS Lambda configuration conventions.

task: Write a Java method that takes an AWS DynamoDB item as a Map<String, AttributeValue> and returns a formatted string representation with attribute names and their string values
solution_criteria: The method should iterate through the map, handle the AttributeValue conversion to String, and produce readable output. It should handle null values gracefully.
